method.band_probability: certified Gaussian anti-concentration log(U/L)/sqrt(2 pi var) with log(U/L) <= U/L - 1, plus the unchanged whole-pair allowance

method.tail: Bernstein: P(sum X >= s) <= exp(-s^2 / (2 (V + M s / 3))), X_k = -Y_k, |Y_k| <= M, E Y_k = 0 and E Y_k^2 = E[Rhat^2] |c_k|^2 / 2 exactly on the N-point midpoint angle grid
